subject: SKU binding & co-sell fallback policy for AWS/Azure/GCP

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Subject: Marketplace SKU binding question (AWS/Azure/GCP)

Hi Markus / Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Two follow-ups from the product team here at Nimbus before we commit to the co-sell package:

1) SKU binding: We need a clear mapping for a single customer purchase that can grant entitlements across all three marketplaces. Right now our licensing system expects one canonical SKU, but each cloud wants a different SKU and entitlement flow.

2) Fallback behavior: If an entitlement can't be validated through the cloud (e.g., private offers on AWS not yet provisioned), we need a documented fallback so customers aren't blocked. Is Redwood able to provide temporary trial entitlements or a hosted proxy while the cloud-side entitlement syncs?

Can you share an example SKU mapping and whatever policy you recommend for a 72-hour provisioning window? If useful, I'll pull our partner ops folks into a short call.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Bell
Head of Partnerships, Nimbus Solutions

Subject: Re: Marketplace SKU binding question (AWS/Azure/GCP)

Hi Sarah — great questions. Putting a concrete proposal below and attaching a sample sku_mapping.csv for your ops team to validate.

Summary proposal:
- Canonical offer: Redwood will designate a canonical SKU (internal) that maps to provider-specific SKUs for AWS/Azure/GCP. That mapping drives entitlement resolution.
- Provisioning window & fallback: If the cloud provider entitlement check fails within 72 hours of purchase, Redwood can issue a time-limited hosted entitlement token (valid up to 72 hours) tied to the canonical SKU. This token gives the customer access to the hosted runtime while partner onboarding completes.
- Audit & reconciliation: All temporary tokens are logged and reconciled against the provider receipts; if a cloud entitlement later materializes, the token is retired and usage is reconciled for billing parity.

Next steps attached: sku_mapping.csv (sample), and a redline of the co-sell agreement with the fallback clause (co_sell_agreement_v2.pdf).

Would you be available for a 30-min triage tomorrow at 10:00 PT? Olga will cover the entitlement mechanics and Laura will confirm the billing treatment.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Partner Integrations — Redwood Inference

Sarah — technical notes below (TL;DR: mapping + token flow is feasible, a few integration caveats).

Technical caveats:
- Provider metadata: Each cloud exposes different entitlement metadata (e.g., AWS private offers include OfferId/Token vs GCP uses licenseId). The sku_mapping.csv includes columns for provider_id and expected webhook events; you’ll need a lightweight shim to normalize.
- Token scoping: Temporary hosted tokens are scoped to the canonical SKU + customer_id; not transferable. We recommend a short TTL (72 hours) and rate-limited access to prevent abuse.
- KV cache & reconciliation: Our runtime will cache entitlement validation for 5 minutes; if reconciliation finds a cloud receipt later, we post a usage event to your billing webhook so downstream invoicing aligns.

Drive folder with the mapping spec and webhook sample: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-syndication-playbook

I can run the sample mapping via a sandbox tomorrow during the call.

— Olga
Olga Petrov

Sarah — picking up on the commercial side. We can support the 72-hour hosted fallback with two constraints:

1) Usage cap: Fallback tokens will be allowed up to an agreed trial-cap (default 100 API units) pending cloud entitlement reconciliation. Anything above moves to pay-as-you-go on Redwood hosted pricing unless cloud entitlement later covers it.
2) Fraud controls: We require partner ops signals (purchase timestamp, partner_id, cloud_offer_id) to trigger fallback issuance. We’ll rate-limit token issuance per partner account.

If Nimbus is comfortable with those constraints, Laura can add the fallback clause to the managed partner addendum and we’ll circulate for signature (DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/DOC-7842-preview).

Laura — can you confirm the billing wording (trial cap and reconciliation mechanics) so we can share a final draft with Nimbus?

Markus / Olga — please bring the sandbox mapping samples to the call so Nimbus can validate.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference
